value.rationale: The classical question of fixed points at a prescribed permutation cycle count acquires a strictly stronger MLR conditional order, comparing every posterior odds ratio. This has direct consequences for monotone conditional tests, and surpasses known stochastic fragmentation/covariance facts. The argument isolates substantive mixed-index positivity, not a cosmetic specialization or mere enumeration.
